title: Start here
summary: Learn Ethereum's execution model, finish one guided build, then choose one current contract toolchain.

links.description: Use the canonical map of accounts, transactions, the EVM, smart contracts, clients, and application frameworks.
Learn by shipping guided contracts and interfaces, starting with tokenization and progressing to DeFi, oracles, and security challenges.
Generate a full-stack Ethereum app with wallet UI, contract hooks, a local chain, and a choice of Hardhat or Foundry.
Build, test, debug, deploy, verify, query, and fork contracts with Forge, Cast, Anvil, and Chisel.
Choose the TypeScript-oriented contract workflow with Solidity and TypeScript tests, viem integration, plugins, and Ignition deployments.

title: Ethereum L1 context
summary: Understand the mainnet fee model and use the right public testnet before deploying value-bearing code.

links.description: Use Sepolia for application testing, reserve Hoodi for validator and protocol work, and avoid deprecated testnets.
Budget L1 transactions by understanding gas used, base and priority fees, refunds, failed execution, and block demand.
